newsitem.title: UK: Ladbrokes launches sporting spread bets.
newsitem.headline: Ladbrokes launches sporting spread bets.

text.p: Ladbrokes said on Friday that it was launching a spread betting operation from this weekend.
"We want to develop the customer's understanding of spread and make it accessible to a much wider audience than it has been so far," said Nigel Taylor, general manager of Ladbrokes Sporting Spreads.
"Our innovative range of spreads will help deliver interesting options to those customers, and our service will be of the highest possible quality," he said.
Ladbrokes Sporting Spreads aims to attract 5,000 account holders in its first year and has spent a million pounds on its launch campaign.
